entries.source: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
entries.target: 从蜜蜂树的一根树根上切下来的断端。它偶尔会蠕动下，似乎不承认它已经死了，而且还是个“植物”。

entries.source: blink to a nearby random location within range %d (based on Magic)
entries.target: 随机传送到%d码范围内的位置(基于魔法)
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔法，+5 意志，+4 灵巧

entries.source: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
entries.target: 善用诡计取胜的潜行斗士。小心，他们会偷走你的生命！

entries.source: You require a weapon and a shield to use this talent.
entries.target: 你需要一把武器一个盾牌来施展这个技能。
并被喂给了幼龙们分食

entries.source:
Conjures %d missile-shaped rocks that you target individually at any target or targets in range.  Each missile deals %0.2f physical damage, and an additional %0.2f bleeding damage every turn for 5 turns.
		At talent level 5, you can conjure one additional missile.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
释放出 %d 个岩石飞弹，你可以为每个飞弹独立指定射程内的任意目标。每个飞弹造成 %0.2f 物理伤害和每回合 %0.2f 流血伤害，持续 5 回合。
		在等级 5 时，你可以额外释放一个飞弹。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
entries.target: 从巨型蜘蛛身上扯下的一大块丑陋的器官，少量的丝线从某个洞中伸出。
暴击时 酸性溅射伤害

entries.source: With blinding speed you suddenly appear next to a target up to %d spaces away and attack for %d%% damage.
entries.target: 你以难以置信的速度闪现至附近 %d 码的一个目标身边并造成 %d%% 伤害。

entries.source: As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
entries.target: 像其他解剖的器官一样，这个肾脏很难看。

entries.source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
entries.target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。
你的傀儡当前尚未被激活。

entries.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They were left behind by the powerful Sher'tul race.
This farportal is not connected to any other portal. It is made for exploration; you cannot know where it will send you.
It should automatically create a portal back, but it might not be near your arrival zone.
entries.target:
传送门是可以在眨眼间将你传送出很远距离的工具。它们是由强大的夏·图尔种族留下的。
这道传送门并没有和其他传送门相连接。它只是用来探索异度空间的，你不知道它将会把你送到哪里。
它应该会自动建立起返回的传送门，但可能该传送门不在你所传送的位置。

entries.source: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
entries.target: 这颗牙齿饱受岁月的侵蚀，但是仍然能胜任它的工作。

entries.source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
entries.target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

entries.source: Translucent and delicate-looking, but surprisingly durable.
entries.target: 半透明的翅膀看起来很脆，实际上你会发现它异常的坚韧。

entries.source: It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.
entries.target: 它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——不时闪着光芒。

entries.source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
entries.target: 一只米诺陶的鼻子的前半部分，上面有圆环装饰。

entries.source: You cannot be stealthy with such heavy armour on!
entries.target: 你不能在身着重甲的情况下潜行！

entries.source:
Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using slings.
		Also, increases your reload rate by %d.
entries.target:
使用投石索时提高 %d%% 武器伤害，获得 30 物理强度。
		同时，每次装填额外恢复 %d 枚弹药。
暴击时 自然溅射伤害

entries.source: Renegade mages from Angolwen, the Sorcerers have set up in the Far East, slowly growing corrupt. Now they must be stopped.
entries.target: 来自安格利文的叛逃法师——巫师们已在远东立足，并逐渐腐化堕落。现在必须阻止他们。
